COL.P.2.1-5.text: Absent in Body, Present in Spirit

COL.1.3-3.text: Paul thanks God whenever he prays for the Colossians

COL.1.4-6.text: Paul has heard of the Colossians’ faith and love

COL.1.7-8.text: Epaphras taught them and told Paul about their love

COL.1.9-10.text: Paul prays that the Colossians will know God’s will

COL.1.11-12.text: Paul prays that God will make them strong and thankful

COL.1.13-14.text: God rescued us and brought us into his Son’s kingdom

COL.1.15-17.text: The Son is the image of God and created all things

COL.1.18-20.text: The Son is head of the church and brings peace

COL.1.21-23.text: God has made you holy if you continue in the faith

COL.1.24-27.text: Paul suffers for the church and shares God’s mystery

COL.1.28-29.text: Paul teaches everyone and works hard for them

COL.2.1-3.text: Paul struggles for believers in Colossae and Laodicea

COL.2.4-5.text: Paul warns against deception and is glad of their faith

COL.2.6-7.text: Believers should keep living in Christ with thanks

COL.2.8-9.text: Paul warns believers not to follow empty human teaching

COL.2.10-12.text: Believers are complete in Christ and raised with him

COL.2.13-15.text: God made believers alive and forgave all their sins

COL.2.16-17.text: No one should judge believers about food or feasts

COL.2.18-19.text: Believers must not follow those with false humility

COL.2.20-23.text: Believers died with Christ and need not obey human rules

COL.3.1-4.text: Believers should think about things above, where Christ is

COL.3.5-8.text: Paul tells believers to put away sin and anger

COL.3.9-11.text: Believers have put on the new self and must not lie

COL.3.12-14.text: Believers should be kind and forgiving and put on love

COL.3.15-17.text: Believers should let Christ’s peace rule and give thanks

COL.4.1-1.text: Masters must treat their slaves fairly

COL.4.2-4.text: Paul asks believers to pray for him and his preaching

COL.4.5-6.text: Paul urges believers to be wise and kind to outsiders

COL.4.7-9.text: Paul sends Tychicus and Onesimus to tell the news

COL.4.10-11.text: Aristarchus, Mark and Jesus Justus send greetings

COL.4.12-14.text: Epaphras, Luke and Demas send greetings to the Colossians

COL.4.15-17.text: Paul sends greetings and tells Archippus to finish his work

COL.4.18-18.text: Paul ends the letter with his own greeting
